Topics covered: Global Health Challenges of Infectious diseases, Principle methods
and study designs in infectious disease epidemiology, Disease Outbreak
Investigation and Control, Applied Epidemiology on Febrile Disease Surveillance
(Typhoid Fever Surveillance in Africa Programme), Research Ethics and Good
Practice for Sample Collection in Febrile Illness Study.
-­‐ Introduction to Systematic Review & Meta – Analysis of clinical trials, Online
Training, John Hopkins University, School of Public Health. 16/06/2016.
Topics covered: Introduction to systematic review and meta-analysis, framing the
question, Searching Principles and bias assessment, assessing the bias in clinical
trial, planning the meat – analysis, Statistic methods for Meta-analysis.
-­‐ Project management using MS project, developed by the Project Management
Team of IVI. International Vaccine Institute (IVI), republic of Korea. 14/06/2016 –
28/06/2016.
Topics covered: Definition of project and project manager, project scheduling using
MS project and communication management using MS Office.
-­‐ Project risk management, developed by the Project Management Team of IVI.
International Vaccine Institute (IVI), republic of Korea. 12/10/2016 – 26/10/2016.
Topic covered: Risk definition, Risk management process, Benefit of risk
management in a project and risk management case studies.
-­‐ Vaccinology, International Vaccine Institute (IVI), Seoul, Korea, September 26-
30, 2016.
Topics covered: fundamentals (Epidemiology and Immunology), Vaccine Discovery
and Preclinical, Clinical Development and Regulatory, Vaccine Introduction from
Development to Introduction, Vaccine Development from Introduction to Acceptance
and Use.
-­‐ Clinical Trial Design, Online Training, Pharmaschool. Ongoing
Topics covered: Data & Endpoints (Eligibility Criteria, Demographic Data, Past
Medical History, Concomitant Medication, Baseline Data, Endpoint Data, Surrogate
Endpoints), Fundamental Trial Designs (Parallel group Trial, Cross Over Trial,
Factorial design, Non Comparative Trial), Randomization (Stratification,

Minimization), Blinding and Masking (Open Label Trial, Single Bind, Double Blind,
Triple Blind, Dummy Double), Comparator (Placebo, Active Comparators), Types of
comparison (Non – Inferiority, Equivalence, Differences Comparison).

-­‐ Pharmacovigilance for Clinical Trials, Online Training, Pharmaschool. Ongoing
Topics covered: Sponsor’s responsibilities, Reporting time frames, Minimum criteria
for reporting, How to report, Informing Investigators, IEC/IRB for new of new safety
information, Development of Safety Update Report.
